title: COMMUNICATION FROM THE CITY ADMINISTRATIVE OFFICER relative to six personal services contracts between the Bureau of Sanitation and Arakelian Enterprises,…
text:
[Council File 23-1032-S1]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Been Held]
COMMUNICATION FROM THE CITY ADMINISTRATIVE OFFICER relative to six personal services contracts between the Bureau of Sanitation and Arakelian Enterprises, Inc. (dba Athens Services), Nasa Services, Inc., Consolidated Disposal Services, LLC (dba Republic Services, Universal Waste Systems, Ware Disposal, Inc., and USA Waste of California (dba Waste Management), for solid waste collection and disposal services for commercial and multi-family properties. (Energy and Environment Committee report to be submitted in Council. If public hearing is not held in Committee, an opportunity for public comment will be provided.) (Please visit lms.lacity.gov for background documents.)
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
TIME LIMIT FILE - JANUARY 23, 2027 LAST DAY FOR COUNCIL ACTION - JANUARY 22, 2027
summary: Six city contracts with private haulers, including Athens, Republic and Waste Management, for trash collection and disposal at commercial and multi-family properties.
